cohort: Use the six existing training dialogues and all registered questions in sessions 5-6 and 7-8. Process the 12 windows in the order of the parent factorial manifest. The temporal control was previously measured. No relation writer endpoint has been inspected at registration. Calibration uses only the 24 raw sessions 1-4 from those six training dialogues, without questions or returns.
intervention: Retain the actual temporal first action, complete prefix bank, ordered input retrieval, K=3 and first two terminal slots. Compare the original capture_temporal_context writer to the bank's handle_entity_relationships writer carrying the identical dated_single_turns source rule. Keep both original templates. If the relation skill is already in the fixed slots, log ineligibility. Verify all dated raw items remain available in both final banks, check original writer and reader receipts, and reproduce every native ordered retrieval before considering a pair matched. Report all registered and unmatched windows. This screens writer effects; no unscreened return is used as a selection reward.
policy: Encode each session source and the original descriptions of the relation and temporal skills with the frozen Qwen state encoder. Score the difference in cosine similarity to relation vs temporal. Center on the median of the 24 earlier training sources and scale by their interquartile range. Clip the standardized value to [-1,1] and multiply by 2; a zero range yields zero shift. Freeze all 12 shifts before running the new writer. Add the shift to the checkpoint's conditional relation-minus-temporal logits at the measured terminal state. Register both probabilities before the writer call. The physically measured pair determines exact expected question F1 under each probability.
controls: Report native conditional probabilities, the source-affinity policy, a constant equal to the unweighted mean proposed relation probability on the matched windows, and both fixed skills. Weight questions equally for F1. Compare per conversation and publish type, ordered retrieval, costs and both answers. Treat this as an exploratory training panel. Seek +.02 versus native plus positive gains versus both fixed arms and the usage control before a separate validation trial. A single window cannot distinguish placement from an overall rate change.
